title: GDD T-117 — Contenido remoto endurecido: rollback, checksum, modo degradado (§12)
description: Harden the TASK-016 Addressables architecture proof into the production §12 pipeline. Two layers: local group Barcade-Core in StreamingAssets (framework, 9 mechanics, base assets, emergency minimum pool — updatable only by reinstall) and remote group Barcade-Microgames over HTTP(S) (definitions, pools, GameTuning, variant assets — fleet-pushable). Operational flow: catalog check at boot and every N hours during ATTRACT; delta bundles download in background; new content activates only at the NEXT session cycle, never mid-game. Degraded mode: without network the cabinet runs indefinitely on last cached content, or ultimately the local minimum pool — a bar without internet never has a dead machine. Versioning: monotonic contentVersion; previous version kept in cache; automatic rollback if the new version fails schema validation (TASK-030 validator) or the load smoke test. Security minimum: HTTPS catalog + per-bundle checksum, mismatched hash rejected (full crypto signing explicitly deferred to fleet phase). Extends docs/remote-content.md. Read GDD §12 + TASK-016 artifacts before coding.
acceptance_criteria: Content activation is session-cycle-gated: an update arriving mid-session is staged and activates only after GAME_OVER -> ATTRACT (test via simulated session clock)
Degraded mode: network cut at any stage (catalog fetch, bundle download) leaves the cabinet fully playable on cached or minimum-local content, verified by fault-injection tests

Rollback: a staged version failing schema validation or load smoke automatically reverts to the previous cached version, with the failure recorded (telemetry event if TASK-033 available, log otherwise)
Checksum enforcement: any bundle whose hash mismatches the catalog entry is rejected and triggers the degraded/rollback path
contentVersion is monotonic and surfaced to replay (.bcrp header) and telemetry headers
EditMode/PlayMode tests cover the update-check state machine; docs/remote-content.md updated with the hardened flow, rollback and checksum sections
